title: BC Telemetry Buddy .. now with (community) knowledge
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy now includes a two-layer knowledge base that shares telemetry troubleshooting patterns and investigation playbooks across the community. The tool stores both shared community knowledge and local customer-specific insights as markdown files, allowing the AI to start problem-solving with context rather than from scratch.
key_points: Knowledge base has two layers: community articles that ship with the tool and local articles stored in your workspace
Users can ask the AI to save new telemetry patterns and solutions back to the knowledge base after investigations
Community articles can be individually excluded if you disagree with their advice
Knowledge base works across all AI clients (VS Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Copilot Chat) at the server level
Articles are plain markdown files stored in GitHub, encouraging community contributions of proven KQL patterns and playbooks
